verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for a SaaS platform with a public API, so the story applies. However, the evidence pack documents only Marketing Emails API endpoints and an official MCP server, with nothing on access scopes, private-app tokens, or least-privilege credential issuance. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
